name: Prism Shard
cardText: RESONATE: Gain +1/+1.
flavorText: Vibrates when you cast spells. Also when nervous. Also when you LOOK at it. Very sensitive crystal.

name: Crystal Spark
cardText: Deal 1 damage. Draw a card.
flavorText: A tiny zap. A tiny card. A tiny WIN. The Crystalline consider this 'foreplay for a spell chain.'

name: Facet Moth
cardText: RESONATE: Summon a 1/1 Crystal Shard.
flavorText: Casts spells, makes babies. Spell babies. They're sharp and slightly magical and they're EVERYWHERE.

name: Arcane Missile
cardText: Deal 3 damage randomly split among all enemies.
flavorText: Aim? Where we're going we don't NEED aim. Three damage goes wherever it FEELS like going.

name: Mana Siphon
cardText: Gain 1 Crystal this turn only. Draw a card.
flavorText: Borrow power from the universe. The universe doesn't notice. Pocket the change and a card.

name: Geode Apprentice
cardText: RESONATE: Deal 1 damage to a random enemy.
flavorText: Studies hard. Zaps harder. Graduated top of her class in Applied Crystal Violence.

name: Refraction Bolt
cardText: Deal 2 damage. If you cast another spell this turn, deal 4 instead.
flavorText: Alone: a spark. After another spell: a THUNDERBOLT. The Crystalline invented the combo meal.

name: Spell Weaver
cardText: Your spells cost (1) less. (Minimum 1.)
flavorText: Discount magic. No coupons required. She's been subsidizing spellcraft since before you drew your opening hand.

name: Prismatic Bolt
cardText: Deal 3 damage to a minion.
flavorText: Three colors. Three damage. It hits like a rainbow with a grudge and no forgiveness.

name: Crystal Golem
cardText: RESONATE: Gain +0/+2.
flavorText: Gets tougher every time you cast. The strong, silent type. By Turn 6 it's a 2/11 and NOBODY can kill it.

name: Resonance Mage
cardText: RESONATE: Add a random spell to your hand. It costs (1).
flavorText: Casts spells. Gets spells. Casts THOSE spells. Gets MORE spells. She hasn't run out since the Prism Age.

name: Shatter
cardText: Deal 4 damage. If this kills the target, deal 2 damage to adjacent minions.
flavorText: Break one, crack two. Crystal physics. The Crystalline textbook has one chapter and it's called 'SHATTER.'

name: Quartz Warden
cardText: GUARDIAN. RESONATE: Gain BARRIER.
flavorText: Shields up when you spell up. Cast twice and it's a GUARDIAN with BARRIER. Cast three times and it's a wall with feelings.

name: Spell Surge
cardText: Draw 2 cards. If you've cast 2+ spells this turn, draw 3 instead.
flavorText: More spells. More cards. More spells FROM cards. It's a cycle and the Crystalline have NO intention of breaking it.

name: Prism Shield
cardText: Give a minion +2/+4 and BARRIER.
flavorText: Looks like glass. Hits like diamond. The Crystalline don't do 'decorative.' Everything is a weapon.

name: Energized Sentry
cardText: Gains +1 Attack for each spell you've cast this turn.
flavorText: Charges up while you cast. Cast four spells and it's a 6/4. Cast six and it's asking for a raise.

name: Prismora Scholar
cardText: DEPLOY: Add 2 random Crystalline spells to your hand.
flavorText: Knowledge is power. Two knowledges is MORE power. She hasn't bought a spell in years. They just COME to her.

name: Arcane Explosion
cardText: Deal 2 damage to all enemy minions. Deal 1 extra for each spell you've cast this game. (Max +5.)
flavorText: Turn 1: weak. Turn 10: APOCALYPTIC. The longer the game goes, the angrier the explosion gets. Like a fine wine of FIRE.

name: Living Crystal
cardText: RESONATE: Gain +1/+1 AND deal 1 damage to a random enemy. (Triggers both on each spell.)
flavorText: Double resonance. Double trouble. Cast one spell and it grows AND hurts someone. Cast five and it's a war crime.

name: Refract
cardText: Deal 3 damage. Cast a random spell that costs (3) or less. (Targets chosen randomly.)
flavorText: One spell becomes two. You paid for damage. You got damage AND a mystery bonus. Chaos is a FEATURE.

name: Crystal Colossus
cardText: RESONATE: Gain +2/+2 and SWIFT.
flavorText: Cast one spell and a 5/6 becomes a 7/8 with SWIFT. The bigger they resonate, the harder your opponent cries.

name: Arcane Storm
cardText: Deal 1 damage to all enemies for each spell you've cast this turn. (Includes this one.)
flavorText: Step 1: Cast five spells. Step 2: Cast THIS. Step 3: Six damage to everything. Step 4: Apologize to nobody.

name: Spell Thief
cardText: DEPLOY: Copy the last spell your opponent cast. It costs (0).
flavorText: What's yours is mine. Especially your best spell. She doesn't have original ideas. She has BETTER theft.

name: Overload
cardText: Your next spell this turn costs (0) and deals double damage.
flavorText: UNLIMITED POWER! (Limited to one use per cast.) The Crystalline definition of restraint.

name: Prismatic Dragon
cardText: RESONATE: Deal 3 damage to a random enemy.
flavorText: Every spell you cast, it breathes fire. EVERY one. It's not a dragon problem. It's a dragon REFLEX.

name: Cascade
cardText: Deal 6 damage to a minion. If this kills it, cast this again on a random enemy minion.
flavorText: It keeps going until something stops it. Nothing stops it. The Crystalline motto: WHY STOP?

name: Crystal Titan
cardText: RESONATE: Gain +2/+2 and deal 2 damage to all enemies.
flavorText: The mountain doesn't just listen to your spells. It casts BACK. In the form of earthquakes and stat buffs.

name: Prismatic Annihilation
cardText: Deal 10 damage split randomly among all enemies. Costs (1) less for each spell you've cast this game. (Min 1.)
flavorText: All the colors of the rainbow. All the damage of a supernova. By Turn 8 this costs pocket change.

name: Resonance Chamber
cardText: Your RESONATE effects trigger an additional time.
flavorText: Say it again. Louder. LOUDER. The Chamber has one rule: everything happens TWICE.

name: Crystal Battery
cardText: LAST WORDS: Gain 2 Crystals this turn only.
flavorText: Breaks open. Power falls out. The world's least efficient battery and the Crystalline's favorite piñata.

name: Spell Amplifier
cardText: Your spells deal 2 extra damage.
flavorText: Makes everything louder. EVERYTHING. Your 1-damage plink is now a 3-damage punch. She doesn't apologize.

name: Resonance Cascade
cardText: Trigger all friendly RESONATE effects twice.
flavorText: Every crystal on the board goes BOING. Then BOING again. Two boings. Unconditional. No spells required.

name: Geode Sage's Staff
cardText: Your Hero Power costs (0) this turn. After you use it, draw 2 cards.
flavorText: The sage's secret: free magic and free cards. She wrote it down. In a book. That she also made free.

name: Arcane Repository
cardText: Whenever you cast a spell, add a copy of it to your hand. It costs (2) more.
flavorText: Spells come back. With a surcharge. The Crystalline invented spell insurance and it's EXPLOITABLE.

name: Prismora Channeler
cardText: RESONATE: The next spell you cast this turn costs (2) less.
flavorText: Fuels the fire while standing in the fire. Every spell you cast makes the NEXT spell cheaper. Infinite discount energy.

name: Feedback Loop
cardText: Deal 2 damage to a minion. If you've cast 3+ spells this turn, cast this again. (Repeatable.)
flavorText: Infinite loop. Finite targets. If you cast three spells before this, it just keeps GOING until nothing moves.

name: Crystal Wyrm
cardText: RESONATE: Gain DOUBLE STRIKE until end of turn.
flavorText: One spell makes it attack twice. Two spells? Still twice. But now it's BIGGER and attacking twice. Much worse.

name: Mana Flood
cardText: Gain 3 Crystals this turn only. Draw a card for each unspent Crystal.
flavorText: Too much mana? IMPOSSIBLE. Too many cards? Also impossible. The Crystalline don't believe in 'enough.'

name: Prismatic Barrier
cardText: Give all friendly minions BARRIER. Draw a card for each BARRIER given.
flavorText: Everyone gets a shield! And a card! Best day ever. Worst day for your opponent. Same day technically.

name: Runic Golem
cardText: Gains +2/+2 for each spell in your hand.
flavorText: Checks your hand. Gets HUGE. Three spells? It's a 10/12. Empty hand? It's sad. Keep your hand full.

name: Arcane Singularity
cardText: Deal damage to all enemies equal to the number of spells you've cast this game.
flavorText: The longer the game, the harder this hits. Turn 12 after casting 15 spells? Fifteen to the FACE of everything.

name: Crystallize
cardText: Transform a minion into a 0/1 Crystal Shard.
flavorText: Was a dragon. Now a paperweight. The Crystalline don't kill things. They REDECORATE them.

name: Mana Vortex
cardText: End of Turn: If you cast 3+ spells this turn, fill your hand with random spells.
flavorText: Cast enough and the universe sends MORE. It's a subscription service. The content is violence.

name: Spellfire Elemental
cardText: DEPLOY: Cast a random spell from your deck. (Targets chosen randomly.)
flavorText: Doesn't READ spells. Just THROWS them. It reached into your deck and YEET'd the first thing it found.

name: Prismatic Lens
cardText: Spells in your hand swap costs with minions in your hand. (Cheapest spell swaps with most expensive minion.)
flavorText: Everything is wrong. But in the RIGHT way. Your 7-cost Titan now costs 1. Your 1-cost spark costs 7. DEAL WITH IT.

name: Chain Lightning
cardText: Deal 3 damage to a minion. If it dies, cast this on a random enemy minion. Repeats up to 3 times.
flavorText: Bolt bounces. Target dies. Bolt bounces AGAIN. Three kills maximum. Usually three kills exactly.

name: Spell Stockpile
cardText: Draw a card for each spell you've cast this turn. (Includes this one.)
flavorText: Cast four spells then play this: draw FIVE cards. The Crystalline reward you for doing what you were going to do ANYWAY.

name: Arcane Familiar
cardText: Whenever you cast a spell, gain +1/+1 permanently.
flavorText: Every spell makes it bigger. Permanently. By mid-game it's a 9/9 that started as a 2/2. Growth through spellcasting.

name: Volatile Crystal
cardText: LAST WORDS: Cast a random spell from your hand for free. (Targets chosen randomly.)
flavorText: Dies. Flings a spell on the way out. It's a crystal piñata full of random violence. The Crystalline LOVE piñatas.

name: Spell Echo
cardText: The next spell you cast this turn is cast twice. (Targets chosen randomly for the second cast.)
flavorText: Cast one spell. Get two. The copy goes wherever it WANTS. You don't control the echo. The echo controls ITSELF.

name: CHAIN IGNITION
cardText: Deal 1 damage to a random enemy. Cast this again for each spell you've cast this turn. (Includes this one.)
flavorText: One damage. Then one more. Then one MORE. Cast five spells before this and it fires SIX times. It doesn't stop. It counts your spells and it fires THAT many bolts and every single one is aimed at something your opponent likes.

name: LIVING SPELLBOOK
cardText: DEPLOY: Discover a spell. It costs (0). Whenever you cast a spell, add a random spell to your hand that costs (1) less than the spell you cast.
flavorText: It's not a book. It's a FACTORY. Every spell you cast, it manufactures a CHEAPER one. Play a 5-cost spell, get a random 4-cost for free. The shelf restocks itself. FOREVER.

name: RESONANCE OVERLOAD
cardText: Trigger ALL friendly RESONATE effects three times. For the rest of this turn, your spells trigger RESONATE an additional time.
flavorText: Triple boing. Then every spell after this double-triggers every crystal. It's not a spell. It's a resonance EARTHQUAKE. Your board lights up like a crystal chandelier full of grenades.

name: PRISMATIC ANOMALY
cardText: RESONATE: Cast a copy of the spell that triggered this. (Targets chosen randomly.) Your spells cost (1) less.
flavorText: You cast a spell. It copies that spell. The copy triggers ANOTHER resonate. Which copies AGAIN. It's a spell mirror that doesn't know when to stop reflecting. The Crystalline are terrified of it. They also worship it.

name: THE GRAND CASCADE
cardText: Cast a copy of every spell you've cast this turn. (Targets chosen randomly.) Draw 3 cards.
flavorText: Everything you cast today? Cast it ALL AGAIN. Five spells? Five free copies. Ten spells? The game is already over but here are TEN MORE. Plus three cards because the Crystalline believe in EXCESS.

name: GEODE SAGE LUMIS
cardText: DEPLOY: For the rest of the game, your spells cost (2) less and trigger all friendly RESONATE effects twice. Your Hero Power reads: "The next spell you cast costs (0)."
flavorText: He didn't master Prismora's crystals. He IS Prismora's crystals. Every facet of his body is a spell amplifier. He sneezes and three RESONATE effects trigger. He's not a mage. He's a geological EVENT.

name: THE INFINITE PRISM
cardText: Can't attack. End of Turn: Cast a copy of every spell you cast this turn. (Targets chosen randomly.) Your spells cost (1) less.
flavorText: It does nothing. Then it does EVERYTHING. Twice. Every spell you cast gets replayed at end of turn for free. It's a crystal that watches you all day then COPIES YOUR HOMEWORK. And it gets an A.

name: ARCHMAGE PRISCILLA
cardText: DEPLOY: Fill your hand with random spells. They all cost (1). For the rest of the game, whenever you cast a spell, your next spell costs (1) less.
flavorText: A hand full of cheap spells. Every cast discounts the next. She doesn't run out. She doesn't slow down. She casts until the board is empty and her hand is full AGAIN.

name: CRYSTAL ANARCHIST ZAEL
cardText: DEPLOY: For the rest of the game, whenever EITHER player casts a spell, trigger all YOUR RESONATE effects.
flavorText: He hijacked resonance itself. Now YOUR opponent's spells power YOUR crystals. They cast a heal? Your board grows. They cast removal? Your board grows. Every spell in the game is HIS fuel.

name: THE FIRST SPELL
cardText: Costs (0). Deal 1 damage to a random enemy for each spell you've cast this ENTIRE game. Draw 3 cards. This can only be cast once per game.
flavorText: Zero mana. Maximum damage. It counts every spell you ever cast and delivers the bill in one hit. Turn 15 after 20 spells? Twenty damage and three cards. It's the universe's invoice. It's due NOW. One cast. Ever. Make it count.
